_comment: Single source of truth for Backlog.md ports on this host.
Read by BOTH bb-ports.sh (to start/stop each project's Web UI) and
bb-aggregate.py (to build the dashboard project list and links), so the
dashboard can never disagree with what is actually running.
Each project must contain its own Backlog.md container: either
backlog/config.yml (default) or .backlog/config.yml (what we use here).
Backlog.md rejects any --backlog-dir that points outside the project,
so a shared container is not possible.
Fields per project:
name     unique short id, used by: bb-ports.sh start|stop <name>
path     absolute path to the project directory (must exist)
group    heading this project is filed under on the dashboard
ui_port  preferred port; if taken, the next free port is used instead
knowledge  what belongs to this project. Read by BOTH the 6424
reader and the panel injected into this project's board,
so knowledge follows the project instead of being
hardcoded to one wiki_id / one notes dir:
note_subdirs  dirs under MyTask/memory holding this project's notes
wikis         wiki_id list from MemoryKnowledge; [] = none
panel         true = inject the knowledge panel into this board
extra_links: services that are reachable but are NOT Backlog.md
projects (no container, no tasks). Rendered by bb-aggregate.py as a
separate group so they are never mistaken for a project board:
name  label on the tile
port  TCP port; link is built from bind_ip
desc  one-line description
group heading, defaults to "Other services"

extra_links.name: 知识与笔记
extra_links.desc: 全平台知识总览：按项目分组浏览 wiki 与笔记
